title: Integration normalization under a vector presentation of a section invariant
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum P and A=A_{E,n} of [def-pur-conventions], with arbitrary finite E/Q_l and n>=1. Let B be a separated finite-type k-scheme and q:N->B a smooth separated finite-type morphism of pure dimension d. Let F be a finite locally free O_B-module of rank d, with vector bundle pi:E->B and zero z [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Let e:E~N be a scheme isomorphism satisfying q e=pi and e z=s for a map s:B->N. The Noetherian hypothesis on B in the Lean statement is a consequence of finite type over k. Let theta_q:omega_q~A_N(d)[2d] be the specified ordinary-etale presentation of the diagonal orientation [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object, lem-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-normalization]. Fix a normalized Tate pullback presentation t and a counit-normalized compact-support presentation M. Let gamma:A_E(d)[2d]~omega_pi be an isomorphism whose hom is the actual adjunction transpose of the canonical integration t_pi, preceded by the inverse canonical Tate pullback along pi [def-amb-vector-integration, thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity]. Let R_e:C(q,s)~C(pi,z) be the specified etale section restriction using M [def-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-data]. Then
T_s Ls*(theta_q) = T_z Lz*(gamma^-1) R_e
as isomorphisms C(q,s)~A_B(d)[2d], with the derived coefficient-unit comparisons included as in chartSectionOrientation and chartSectionEtaleRestriction. The same fixed Tate transport t is used on both sides. This includes d=0 and empty B. No arbitrary orientation is assumed to be canonical.

proof.text: Use each linear frame to identify the canonical integration with the ordered affine trace. Its adjunction transpose is the inverse normalized ordinary orientation by the affine counit formula. Vector-purity base change makes these equations agree on common refinements; remove the even shift and apply the degree-zero equality test to obtain the equation for the whole bundle.

proof.text: Apply chartOrientation_etale_restriction to e and q. Invert this equation, pull back by z, and use q e=pi and e z=s. The coefficient-unit comparison and pullback compositors are precisely chartSectionEtaleRestriction. Coherence of the canonical Tate pullback identifies T_s with its two-step counterpart, yielding the displayed section equation. Rank zero uses the identity trace; the empty case uses the empty-cover equality test.

theorem normalModelSectionOrientation (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {B N : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian B] (d : ℕ) (q : N ⟶ B)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d q] [IsSeparated q]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType q] [QuasiCompact q]
    (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [IsSeparated aB]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB]
    (s : B ⟶ N) (F : B.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F ≅ N)
    (w : e.hom ≫ q = VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)
    (hs : VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F ≫ e.hom = s)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates)
    (M : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient) :
    letI := P.noetherian aB
    letI := P.noetherian (q ≫ aB)
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).1
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).2.1
    letI := P.noetherian (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F ≫ aB)
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P q aB
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F) aB
    ∀ (γ : P.diagonalTwistEtale (VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F) d ≅
        P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)),
      γ.hom = (Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient
          P.diagonalExponent P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t
          (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F) (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aB) d).inv ≫
        (Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
          (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)).homEquiv _ _
            (Etale.vectorBundleIntegration P.diagonalExponent
              (pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos P.level) P.Coefficient
              P.diagonalExponent_annihilates B (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aB) d F) →
      P.chartSectionOrientation d q aB s t =
        P.chartSectionEtaleRestriction M e.hom q
            (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F) w s
            (VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F) hs ≪≫
          (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
            (VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F)).leftDerivedFunctor.mapIso
              (P.chartDualizingUnit (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F) ≪≫ γ.symm) ≪≫
          Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
            P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t (VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F)
            (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F ≫ aB)) d
